lines: 因你为大，且行奇妙的事；
and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
因你为大，且行奇妙的事；
因你為大，且行奇妙的事；
and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
and do great works of wonder; you only are God.
“Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
“Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
Whoever will give worship to the name of the Lord will get salvation.
他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。
and in him all things are held together.
他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。
他在萬有之先；萬有也靠他而立。
and in him all things are held together.
and in him all things have being.
Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes
Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes
The Lord is full of grace and righteousness; truly
he is a God of mercy.
所以，你们因信基督耶稣都是神的儿子。
For you are all children of God
所以，你们因信基督耶稣都是神的儿子。
所以，你們因信基督耶穌都是神的兒子。
For you are all children of God
Because you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，
Remember your word to your servant
求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，
求你記念向你僕人所應許的話，
Remember your word to your servant
Keep in mind your word to your servant
for on it has my hope been fixed.
神是帮助我的，是扶持我命的。
God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
神是帮助我的，是扶持我命的。
神是幫助我的，是扶持我命的。
God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
God is my helper: the Lord is the great supporter of my soul.
因为经上记着说：「你们要圣洁，
“You shall be holy; for I am holy.”
因为经上记着说：「你们要圣洁，
因為經上記着說：「你們要聖潔，
“You shall be holy; for I am holy.”
Because it has been said in the Writings
But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
But our God is in heaven: he has done whatever was pleasing to him.
是我的诗歌；他也成了我的拯救。
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
是我的诗歌；他也成了我的拯救。
是我的詩歌；他也成了我的拯救。
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.
For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
For the kingdom is the Lord's; he is the ruler among the nations.
神啊，愿列邦称赞你！愿万民都称赞你！
God. Let all the peoples praise you.
神啊，愿列邦称赞你！愿万民都称赞你！
神啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！
God. Let all the peoples praise you.
Let the peoples give you praise
O God; let all the peoples give you praise.
My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
My soul is broken with desire for your decisions at all times.
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord
Make yourselves low in the eyes of the Lord and you will be lifted up by him.
我要向山举目；我的帮助从何而来？
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
我要向山举目；我的帮助从何而来？
我要向山舉目；我的幫助從何而來？
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
My eyes are lifted up to the hills: O where will my help come from?
他们与我为敌以报我爱，
they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
他们与我为敌以报我爱，
他們與我為敵以報我愛，
they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
For my love they give me back hate; but I have given myself to prayer.
whatever you make request for in prayer
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
My flesh is moved for fear of you; I give honour to your decisions.
我要在你的命令中自乐；
这命令素来是我所爱的。
I will delight myself in your commandments
我要在你的命令中自乐；
这命令素来是我所爱的。
我要在你的命令中自樂；
這命令素來是我所愛的。
I will delight myself in your commandments
And so that I may take delight in your teachings
to which I have given my love.
你们各人的重担要互相担当，
如此，就完全了基督的律法。
and so fulfill the law of Christ.
你们各人的重担要互相担当，
如此，就完全了基督的律法。
你們各人的重擔要互相擔當，
如此，就完全了基督的律法。
and so fulfill the law of Christ.
Take on yourselves one another's troubles
and so keep the law of Christ.
